pnl_scope.futures_routes: Directional proxy uses BTC-PERPETUAL mark return before fees/funding/slippage.
pnl_scope.spot_routes: Directional proxy uses BTC spot return before fees/slippage.
pnl_scope.directional_options_routes: Only underlying-direction proxy is tracked; this is NOT option strategy P/L.
pnl_scope.relative_value_or_vol_routes: No directional proxy is assigned because BTC direction alone cannot evaluate these strategies.

note: Exact options P/L requires frozen contract legs, entry quotes, exit quotes, fees and execution assumptions; this ledger does not fabricate those values.
